entities.name: José María Martín de Herrera y de la Iglesia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Martín de Herrera y de la Iglesia was a long-serving cardinal in the Roman Catholic Church in the early years of the twentieth century. Unusually, he served as archbishop of dioceses in more than one different country, being both archbishop of Santiago de Cuba and of Santiago de Compostela during his career in the Church.
